TIME: 20:30 to 20:45
DAY OF THE WEEK: Saturday - 26/7/69
SEASON: Winter
YEAR: 1969
ATMOSPHERIC CONDITIONS: Clear night
MOON: The Moon was to the east, therefore almost opposite the observation, which took place to the northwest.
MOON PHASE: Last day of the waxing phase
VISIBLE STARS: Starry sky
CLOUDS: None
TEMPERATURE: Cool night
HUMIDITY: Dry
WIND: None
RELATIVE POSITION OF OANI/OBSERVERS: Approximately 1 kilometer; 30º altitude; reference: tree
DESCRIPTION OF THE PLACE: Inhabited - little lighting - apparently without anyone in the streets, since it did not attract attention. A horse was nearby.
EXISTENCE OR NOT OF METALLIC, WATER, ETC. REFLECTIONS AT THE TIME OF OBSERVATION: There were no reflections.
PRESENCE NEARBY OF: Houses
ASTRONOMICAL POSITION: Approximately 40º northwest - 30º altitude
OBSERVERS' SITUATION: Outdoors
OBSERVATION MADE: Through 7x50 binoculars and with the naked eye
OCCURRENCE: I was at my residence in Cidade de Deus-Osasco, in the company of my brother-in-law Cid Moura Ferrão, a resident of Campinas-SP, regional Physical Education delegate and owner of the Instituto de Fisioterapia Ferrão in Campinas-SP; his daughter (my niece) Susy Moura Ferrão, aged 15, in the first year of upper secondary school; and my wife, Neide F. Magdalena. Outside the residence were my daughter Syrgéia, aged 14, in the third year of lower secondary school, and my nephew Cid Moura Ferrão Júnior, aged 20, taking the Madureza adult education course.
At 20:30 my daughter and my nephew called us to see a bright red light that had risen from the horizon and had already been stationary in the sky for some time.

Conseguí me comunicar com a Esposa do Cor. Zani, participando o novo aparecimento. Corrí para observar, e através do binóculo, ví a luz abaixar-se atrás da mesma árvore anterior, tornando a elevar-se para transpô-la, vindo em nossa direção, aumentando de tamanho. Foi baixando até o solo, num local escuro, por entre as casas. Deu-me a impressão de vêr, além da luz, um objeto em forma de páraquedas, amarelado. O objeto deveria ter mais ou menos 2 metros, pois pude compará-lo com uma porta de aço, de um prédio.
De automóvel (Wolks), eu e o Sr. Hélio Cerqueira Gama, fomos até o local onde pousou a luz. Vasculhamos todos os caminhos (pois não chegam a ser ruas) esburacados e sem saída, apesar da escuridão. Nada vimos, além de um cavalo, imóvel, mesmo no local que imagino tenha descido a luz. Regressamos à Cidade de Deus às 23 horas, encontrando três dos guardas que fazem a ronda, os quais nos afirmaram ter visto uma bola de fogo, cujo local coincidia com a nossa observação.
Cidade de Deus, 26/7/69

I managed to contact Col. Zani's wife, telling her about the new appearance. I ran to observe and, through the binoculars, saw the light lower itself behind the same tree as before, rising again to pass over it, coming in our direction and growing in size. It descended to the ground in a dark place between the houses. Besides the light, I had the impression of seeing a yellowish, parachute-shaped object. The object must have been approximately 2 meters, because I could compare it with a steel door of a building.
Mr. Hélio Cerqueira Gama and I went by car (Wolks) to the place where the light landed. Despite the darkness, we searched all the potholed paths without exits (they do not even amount to streets). We saw nothing except a motionless horse, right in the place where I imagine the light had descended. We returned to Cidade de Deus at 23:00, meeting three of the guards who patrol the area. They told us they had seen a ball of fire at a location matching our observation.
Cidade de Deus, 26/7/69
